outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care or special care nursery
cohort: 9 twin pregnancies (18 fetuses) with isolated SUA, compared to 27 matched controls
finding: Isolated SUA in twins was associated with preterm birth <34 weeks but not with SGA or perinatal death after controlling for gestational age.
mod_finding: While the study mentions mode of delivery as an outcome examined, it does not report any findings related to the mode of delivery.
